item.title: Retail Jeweller’s Inspiring Independents returns to Jewellery Show London with AG Group as headline sponsor
item.description: Retail Jeweller Retail Jeweller’s Inspiring Independents returns to Jewellery Show London with AG Group as headline sponsor Retail Jeweller’s Inspiring Independents 2026 will return this September, taking place alongside the Jewellery Show London and proudly supported by headline sponsor AG Group. item.title: Pandora launches #LoveLoud movement with National Portrait Gallery panel
item.description: Retail Jeweller Pandora launches #LoveLoud movement with National Portrait Gallery panel Pandora has launched #LoveLoud, a new UK-wide cultural movement encouraging people to express love more openly in everyday life, supported by behavioural science research. item.title: Camden Market trader pleads guilty after £106,000 of unhallmarked silver seized
item.description: Retail Jeweller Camden Market trader pleads guilty after £106,000 of unhallmarked silver seized A Camden Market jewellery trader has pleaded guilty to four offences under the Hallmarking Act 1973 following the seizure of more than £106,000 worth of unhallmarked silver. Camden Market trader pleads guilty after £106,000 of unhallmarked silver seized Ruth Faulkner

item.description: Retail Jeweller Gemporia launches “The Cut With No Name” campaign ahead of exclusive gemstone debut Gemporia is inviting its community to take part in the launch of a brand-new gemstone cut exclusive to the jeweller, currently known as “The Cut With No Name”. item.title: Petition calls for online marketplaces to verify UK hallmark compliance
item.description: Retail Jeweller Petition calls for online marketplaces to verify UK hallmark compliance Jewellery consultant Jayne Bond has submitted a petition to the UK Government calling for online marketplaces to verify UK hallmark compliance before allowing sellers to list precious metal jewellery to UK consumers. Petition calls for online marketplaces to verify UK hallmark compliance Ruth Faulkner

item.title: BRC reports “hard-won” drop in retail crime
item.description: Retail Jeweller BRC reports “hard-won” drop in retail crime The BRC’s Crime Report for 2024–2025 reveals daily incidents of violence and abuse against retail workers were down by a fifth on the previous year, but remain at almost four times pre-pandemic levels.
